status: PROPOSED DESIGNS AND PROVISIONAL NAMES - NOT APPROVED

heroes.concept: A young messenger who knows every ford in the valley. Light on her feet, always wet to the knees.
A hot-headed trainee who burns through bandages faster than the medics can wrap them.
A marsh hunter whose arrows ride the wind. Woven hat, patient eyes.
A quarry boy, built like a door, who carries a shield he cut himself.
A shrine student who still mislabels half her paper charms, and heals you anyway.
A gate sentry who rings a great iron bell on his back to call out raiders.
Nobody sees this courier arrive. Grey wrap, face covered, letters sealed.
A trap-maker with singed eyebrows and pockets full of copper wire.
A night gatherer trailed by pale moths, who knows which leaves close wounds.
A watch-tower sentry who learned to throw shadow when the light goes.
Keeper of the mountain road's lanterns. Calm, huge, and never lets a light go out.
A court performer whose iron war fans cut as cleanly as her steps.
A debt collector with a sickle and chain, who works alone and speaks little.
A monk who meditates on the ice and carries its stillness into battle to soothe wounds.
An old master with a white beard and stone-wrapped fists. He has outlived every rival.
A hermit who carves spirit masks from lightning-struck wood, and wears whichever suits the fight.
A wandering monk whose drum-beats shake stunned raiders off their feet.
A traveller from the salt flats who bends the dry wind around a long glaive.
A sworn hunter of the night shrine. Her arrows are said to be drawn from moonlight.
A veteran who holds the line behind a red-hot tower shield, scarred and unbothered.
A wandering teacher who befriended a spirit-beast of the sun. Warm, loud, and far stronger than he lets on.

forms.name: Wandering Sage
forms.summary: Plain orange and grey training clothes, rope belt, a modest outline.

forms.name: Dawn Disciple
forms.summary: A layered robe over the gi and a faint warm glow at the hands.

forms.name: Beast-Bound Master
forms.summary: Bronze bracers, clan sash, and a small sun-beast spirit at his heel.

forms.name: Celestial Guardian
forms.summary: A radiant armoured mantle and sun disc behind the same weathered face, with the spirit-beast grown large.

heroes.concept: A prodigy who sealed her own sight, and carries a floating glass eye that shows her the path of a blade. It holds illusions rather than bloodline power.

forms.name: Veiled Student
forms.summary: A dark red training coat and a plain cloth blindfold over both eyes.

forms.name: Glass Seer
forms.summary: A single floating glass orb orbits her, showing what she can't see.

forms.name: Mirror Duelist
forms.summary: A fitted long coat with silver stitching, and three glass orbs turning in a ring.

forms.name: Crimson Witness
forms.summary: A tall collared mantle of red glass shards, a full ring of orbs, and an illusory second blade.

heroes.concept: A storm-court apprentice who rose to rule the sky over her mountain. Icy, precise, and always the last to raise her voice.

forms.name: Storm Apprentice
forms.summary: Plain indigo travel wear with a single copper hairpin.

forms.name: Court Herald
forms.summary: A fitted court coat, with small sparks held under tight control.

forms.name: Tempest Regent
forms.summary: Ornate shoulder plates and a clan sigil crackling with charge.

forms.name: Thunder Empress
forms.summary: A tall crowned outline and a mantle of living lightning.

heroes.concept: A quarry labourer who stood his ground in a landslide, and the mountain has stayed with him ever since.

forms.name: Quarry Hand
forms.summary: A broad labourer in worn leather with a stone maul.

forms.name: Wallkeeper
forms.summary: Fitted slate plates and a calm haze of dust at his feet.

forms.name: Ridge Bastion
forms.summary: Carved clan armour with runes that glow when struck.

forms.name: Stone Titan
forms.summary: Towering living-rock armour around the same weathered face.

heroes.concept: A shrine orphan raised by a white wolf-spirit. She mends the living and speaks for the moon.

forms.name: Shrine Novice
forms.summary: Plain grey shrine robes and a wooden charm.

forms.name: Night Seer
forms.summary: Layered silver-trim robes and a dim lunar halo.

forms.name: Fang Priestess
forms.summary: Crescent fang jewellery, floating ward talismans and a small spirit wolf.

forms.name: Moonfang Oracle
forms.summary: A sweeping crescent mantle, full moonlight, and the wolf-spirit standing beside her.

heroes.concept: A scholar who opened a door nobody should, and came back wearing a crown that isn't quite there.

forms.name: Exiled Scholar
forms.summary: A scuffed scholar's robe, ink-stained sleeves and a small dark orb.

forms.name: Riftwalker
forms.summary: Hooded, with mirror-black shards drifting at the shoulders.

forms.name: Hollow Regent
forms.summary: A high collar, a broken ring of shards, and the first hint of a crown.

forms.name: Void Sovereign
forms.summary: A vast black mantle, a floating hollow crown, and a door of dark glass open behind him.

heroes.concept: A warlord who burned his own banner to stop a war, and has been ashes and embers ever since.

forms.name: Banner Burner
forms.summary: A soot-grey campaign robe, cracked gauntlets and a charred banner pole.

forms.name: Ember Marshal
forms.summary: Blackened plates, with embers glowing through the seams.

forms.name: Pyre Warlord
forms.summary: A horned iron helm and a torn burning cape.

forms.name: Ashen Flame Lord
forms.summary: A crown of horns, a mantle of living ash and a field of pale cursed flame at his feet.

heroes.concept: A mountain scout raised among storm-crows. A beak-masked blur who is gone before the thunder arrives.

forms.name: Ridge Fledgling
forms.summary: A slate scout's wrap, a cloth face cover and short practice blades.

forms.name: Crow Runner
forms.summary: A short feathered capelet and a single crow on the shoulder.

forms.name: Storm Talon
forms.summary: A longer feather cloak and curved blades trailing blue sparks.

forms.name: Storm Crow
forms.summary: Great storm-feather wings, a full beak helm, and afterimages trailing behind him.
